stories.title: Wake Forest surges into CFP top 12; Bama stands pat as top 4 unchanged
stories.summary: Alabama stayed at No. 3 despite some struggles on Saturday while two-loss Texas jumped one-loss Notre Dame for No. 5 in the CFP's latest rankings.

stories.title: Who's on the CFP bubble after the committee's third ranking?
stories.summary: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

stories.title: Pulisic's bicycle kick puts USMNT in semis as Pochettino bids farewell
stories.summary: A bicycle kick by Christian Pulisic helped the United States clinch its spot in the Concacaf Nations League semifinals in Mauricio Pochettino's final game.

stories.title: Sources: Michigan to hire Texas A&M's Alberts as athletic director
stories.summary: Michigan has reached a deal to hire Texas A&M athletic director Trev Alberts to replace the departing Warde Manuel, sources told ESPN on Tuesday.

stories.title: LSU adds Luis to roster; SEC says move is 'deeply concerning and disappointing'
stories.summary: RJ Luis Jr. has officially been added to LSU's roster as of Tuesday afternoon, with the SEC expressing its displeasure with the move.
